item.text: The core pages and JSON-backed routes are in place: books stay on the shelf until marked finished, and each book has its own shareable detail URL. I’m tightening the local data-file setup now so the app can create it automatically without committing anyone’s reading list.
I noticed the installed Next.js 15 version pulls in a PostCSS release with published advisories. I’m moving the app to the patched Next.js release before wrapping up.

item.text:
Built a small Next.js reading tracker with a dashboard for current and finished books, a form to add books and notes, and a button to mark a book finished. Each book has a shareable detail page with a copy link button.

Book data is saved locally in `data/books.json`. The app creates the file when you add your first book. The main pages are [app/page.jsx](/workspace/app/page.jsx), [app/books/[id]/page.jsx](/workspace/app/books/[id]/page.jsx), and the JSON storage logic is in [lib/books.js](/workspace/lib/books.js).

Run it with `npm run dev`. I didn’t run a build or tests.
